Facts: Person (何某) signs rental agreement with car owner (郭某某) for a taxi. Then he lies to victim (马某某) saying he is the owner, signs rental agreement, collects rent and deposit 50,600 yuan. Later car owner recovers car from victim. Victim asks for rent and deposit back, he refuses.

This is essentially fraud: he pretended to be owner, induced victim to pay rent and deposit, with intent to illegally obtain property. So crime: 诈骗 (fraud).
